learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to add and subtract money while pretending to buy our favorite toys!

main_concepts.concept_title: 💰 Buying Toys and Finding the Total
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Every toy in a shop has a price tag. When we want to buy two toys, we add their prices together to find the total money we need to pay!
If the toy costs 15 rupees and we give a 20 rupee note, the shopkeeper gives us money back. We subtract to find our change!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Toy Shop
fun_activity.instructions: Put price tags on your old toys using sticky notes. Ask your parents to buy them using pretend paper money and give them the right change!

quick_recap: ⭐ We use addition to find out how much money we need to pay in total.
⭐ We use subtraction to find out how much change we should get back.
